column3: TextKey
BREAK
AHHHHHHH!
Oh-- It's you! You have to stop scaring the feathers off me!
Almost ruined my hiding spot as well!! Those humans over there knocked the plumage off me!
Did you know that legend says we once helped humans? Carried mail thousands of kilometers for them!
We were heroes! Sky messengers! Tiny feathery delivery legends!
Sounds crazy. I know. Now they mostly just chase and yell at us. Soo SCARY! Humans are unpredictable.
They tend to throw things..kick.. or chase you if they spot you. So when you wanna be invisible… you gotta sneak.
Hold down LEFT CTRL OR LEFT BUMPER and move slowly. Stay behind stuff. Boxes. Benches. Fences. Decorative shrubbery.
To sprint hold down the LEFT SHIFT OR L3.  It will take you out of the stealth mode so be speedy!!  If you see something you want… snatch it up with F.
Feeling confident?  I need some help. I dropped this sweet KEYCHAIN inside the THEATRE! And it’s crowded with people!
If you can grab it I'll let you keep it! Maybe you'll find some use for it later.
Try to sneak past the humans. If they see you… you better move those little feet!
Oh. That’s okay. Totally fine. I’ll just…go get it myself. That’s good. I like practice. Practice is safe.
Just kidding. This one is all you. GO!
YOU ACTUALLY DID IT!!! You’re the bravest bird I know. Which is not a high bar but still!!
OMG! HI!! You’re here!! Okay don’t freak out but I found the BEST stuff!!
It was in a garbage can!! Which means it’s premium.
Okay so like — see shiny? Or crunchy? Or vaguely food-shaped? Just run over and eat! If you can't EAT it try to GRAB it by HOLDING F or X BUTTON
If you're already full you can find it in your wingventory!  Press I OR UP DIRECTION PAD to check out what you got.
Now here’s the BEST part. Use LEFT CLICK OR RIGHT TRIGGER to poop on those pesky humans! And RIGHT CLICK OR LEFT TRIGGER to aim so you waste less!
When your poop meter gets low — You gotta eat. Garbage snacks fill it back up. Nature is BEAUTIFUL.
Garbage cans are like mystery boxes! Use E OR X BUTTON to interact! You never know what you’ll get!
Maybe fries. Maybe bread. Maybe something that builds character. If it wiggles.. maybe don’t.
Hey there kid! You ready to learn some sick moves?
Relax your feathers. The sky’s chill. It only looks big. Okay yeah it’s massive. But you’ll be fine.
You know the basics but you want more! Flying fast is easy. Flying cool? That’s skill.
Need to dive down quickly? Use Q. Maybe a softer approach? Hover with G or just glide on down.
Now let's see you put it all together. Look for race posters like the one on this sign and test your wings! Show me what you got!
Hello young fellow! You look like you're lost? How about some help?
column7: You got that right... All my flo-

column3: All my flo-
ANYWAYYY *Didn't ask your whole life story here*
I have an old nest around here if you want it? It's a fixer-upper but still....good.
Alright
GREAT! It's over near the picnic tables!
Are pigeon nest supposed to look that....bad?
Back in my day we would sleep on spikes and be HAPPY. *SCOFF* Okay maybe you could spruce it up with a few sticks?
Check the nest! Maybe I left a few laying around?
Since you're new around here let me give you a few tips.
Everybody knows us for pooping everywhere. But you need to fill up your tank first! There's bound to be some food around here.
Now I say this because I care.... But you look.... weak. You'll get stronger but we all need some help sometimes.
Try using that manhole for a boost so you have a better chance of getting to the top of that building. It's a great place to hide from angry humans!
How did you get up here so fast?!
Fast...? You took so long I almost left!
You know where to find food.You know how to stay safe. I've saved the best for last!
See those humans down there? You know what to do! Make me proud!
I've taught you everything I know already. Time to go find some other birds to bother!
HEY!! HEY COO!!
Do I know you?
Nope.
BUT has anybirdy told you that you look JUST like someone I know? Suspiciously idential *SQUINTS*
You NEED to meet them!
That's...not helpful. Who is it?
Since you're going anyways can you bring them this bread I owe?
Can't you do it yourself? I didn't agree to this?!
... I get by with a little help from my friends?
Of course you do.
You look… familiar? Odd.
Wingo told me to bring this to you?
Ah the bread he owes. What a WILD night. Thank Wingo for me!
Oh I'm not going back there. I've never met them in my life… and they kind of scare me.
There are lots of us around! Us pigeons have strong genes *winks*
You'll find someone to talk to…I met a bird around here not long ago! Spoke with a strange accent.
Oh! Take these for your trouble. It's the least I can do.
I SAY My good fellow!
You look young and sprightly tough enough to scare a CAT or two!
Mind helping an old chap like myself with a dilemma?
Uhhh. I'm a bit busy-
EXCELLENT my dear bird! Thank you so much!
A pack of mongrels have taken a liking to my favorite alleyway. They have the finest slection here you see…
Not too moldy... but just enough to add some flavor! No other will do!
Anywho those brutes have kept me out long enough.
Give them a good wallop of POOP! THAT oughta teach them a lesson!
Oh I think a young bird got stuck in there too. You look quite like her! Yes! Yes Indeed!
..but more importantly - PLEASE HELP ME GET MY SNACKS BACK!!!
Tally Ho dear friend! - Yes. Off you go!
You found me!! I was SOO scared!
I was hoping Arnesto would come... but I'm soo glad to see you!
Thanks?
Do you know that bird over there? He ran away when the cats came yelling " EAT HER! EAT HER!"
Pish posh - Now off you go! Out of my alleyway!
Don't worry I'm gone...
I'm going to go rest my wings after such an awful day!
Oh! Before I go I met the strangest old Crow. He has a shop around here somewhere! Maybe he'll have something you can trade those trinkets for?
He usually hangs out in alleyways but be careful for these pesky cats. You don't want to spend the night in a dumpster like me.
I hear you are looking for trinkets?
Shop is closed. Come back later…
........ I can see the … Ok I see what's happening. What do you need?
A fair trade is it not? Trinkets for treasures? A deed for a deed.
This stall has become my prison. I seek a ROSE for my true love. Only they can make me feel FREE!
You know you can just leave right?
A traveller of the sky burdened with purpose. Tell me do winds whisper secrets to thee as they do to me?
I get it. Very poetic.
Bring me the rose and you may trade with me. Until then, we're closed.
Crow finds wares… if you have trinkets.
Who...?
